newsitem.title: ITALY: TENNIS-TOP SEED SAMPRAS LOSES IN FIRST ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-TOP SEED SAMPRAS LOSES IN FIRST ROUND.

text.p: Top seed and world number one Pete Sampras crashed out of the Italian Open tennis tournament in the first round on Tuesday to old friend and unseeded fellow-American Jim Courier 7-6 (7-5) 6-4.

It was the second clay court tournament in a row where Sampras had gone out in his first match. He was beaten by Sweden's Magnus Larsson at Monte Carlo last month in his opening clay tournament of the year after a first round bye.

The departure of Sampras left the Italian Open without its top two seeds. Second seed Michael Chang had earlier lost to unseeded Argentine Hernan Gumy 6-3 6-2. Ironically, it was Gumy who dumped Courier out of the tournament last year.
